patient._comment: 'patient' contains the three sections that may be exposed in the detailed patient display: presentation, answer, and clinical.

presentation._comment: The immutable patient evidence package available for triage. Panel context controls whether other sections are locked or available.
presentation.quote: My lower leg is red, hot, and swollen, and it's spreading — I circled the edge this morning and it's already bigger. It started from a little scratch.
presentation.triageNote: 50-year-old female with an expanding area of warm, tender redness and swelling on the right lower leg arising from a small scratch. She marked the edge this morning and it has spread; temperature is 38.1 C.

answer._comment: The authoritative game answer. Explicit ESI, destination, and destination rationale are answer-bearing content; the player's assignment remains session state.
answer.destinationReason: ESI 3 is appropriate because spreading febrile lower-leg inflammation is expected to require multiple evaluation and treatment resources.

clinical._comment: Display-ready clinical interpretation derived from patient.presentation. It preserves clinical meaning but must not explicitly name or identify the correct ESI level or destination; it does not participate in scoring.
clinical.summary: This patient has expanding warmth, tenderness, erythema, and swelling of the right lower leg after a skin break, with temperature 38.1 C.
clinical.acuityReason: The spread beyond a marked border and fever warrant assessment for deeper infection and systemic involvement, although there is no current shock or pain out of proportion.
expectedResources: IV or oral antibiotic treatment based on severity
teachingPoints: Marking the margin helps identify progression but does not replace reassessment.
Pain out of proportion, crepitus, bullae, rapid systemic decline, or hypotension would suggest a deeper destructive infection.

possibleDiagnoses: Deep soft-tissue infection if red flags develop
possibleClinicalOutcome.disposition: Examination and testing would guide antibiotic route and disposition; worsening systemic findings or rapid progression would favor admission.

aiImageGeneration._comment: 'aiImageGeneration' is info for AI to generate the image of the patient. Most images were done with openAI gpt-image-1 using an API, not the app, in July 2026. Look for some python scripts that are used to create these images. Be sure that the anchor-image is available and is provided to the AI - otherwise the images will not be consistent.
aiImageGeneration.pose: seated, pointing at her red, swollen lower leg
aiImageGeneration.prompt: Softly-shaded painterly cartoon illustration in a semi-realistic Pixar/Disney style: smooth gradient shading, soft natural lighting, gentle rounded volumes, fine delicate outlines (NOT thick flat cartoon outlines), warm detailed rendering, natural realistic proportions, single character. Match the painterly STYLE of the attached reference image - its brushwork, shading, line weight, lighting and palette - but do NOT copy its cropping, camera distance or composition. FRAMING (follow exactly): a full-body WIDE SHOT, square 1:1, 3/4 front view, subject centred. The ENTIRE figure must be inside the frame from the top of the head to the soles of both feet, and the ENTIRE chair must be inside the frame including all four chair legs meeting the floor. Leave clear empty margin on all four sides - roughly 10% of the image width as space above the head and below the feet. This is NOT a close-up, NOT a bust, NOT a head-and-shoulders portrait, NOT a cropped view: the camera is pulled well back so the whole person and the whole chair sit comfortably inside the picture with room around them. Draw the COMPLETE body - head, neck, torso, both arms, both hands, lap, both legs, both feet with shoes. Nothing cropped by the edges, no missing or truncated limbs, no body part fading out or right unfinished. ANATOMY AND OBJECTS (critical): exactly one head, exactly two arms ending in exactly two hands, exactly two legs ending in two feet, five fingers on each hand. No extra, duplicated, floating or partial limbs anywhere. Anything the character touches must be plausibly held by one of those two hands. All furniture is solid and fully opaque - the chair must never look transparent or see-through, and its back, seat and legs must all be completely drawn. Subject: a hispanic 50-year-old woman, seated on a blue padded clinic chair. Pose: seated, leaning down to point at her red, swollen lower leg. Expression: mildly uncomfortable and concerned. Clearly visible: a red, swollen lower leg with a finger pointing at the spreading redness. No text, no logos.
